thought.text: Now `just infra-up` in parallel (images already pulled, tiles in place).

reasoning_content:
`just build` runs the following:
- build-frontend (domain-wasm + handbook-pdf + pnpm install + pnpm run build) — the handbook requires typst (already installed ✓)
- build-keycloak-theme
- _compile-backend (SQLX_OFFLINE=true cargo build --release)

Wait, the `build` recipe is: `build: build-frontend build-keycloak-theme _compile-backend`. The frontend build includes handbook-pdf, which compiles the typst manual. Alright, typst 0.15.1 is installed (the version pinned in the Dockerfile — good).

Let's start infra-up in parallel. This runs `_acme-init _ensure-valhalla` and then runs `_compose up -d`. Since the tile tar exists, the valhalla build will be skipped. All the images have already been pulled.

action.command: cd /workspace && export PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" && (nohup just infra-up > /tmp/infra.log 2>&1 &) && echo "infra-up started"
